QUOTE: Add the `MBEDTLS_ERR_<MODULE>_<NAME>` define to the module's public header (for example `include/mbedtls/asn1.h`), in that module's code range. The generator picks it up from the headers. ... Do not edit `library/error.c`. It is regenerated at build time, so a hand edit is overwritten. ... Rebuild through the normal build path so the generator runs.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says to add the define to the public header, not edit error.c, and rerun the generator via the build. It does not mention the /** */ doc-comment form and says the exact format is unconfirmed, but the core mechanism is stated.
